comment: No source is published. The tempo knob is configured -2 to 4 with a display base of 2 and a multiplier of 60, so 15 to 960 beats per minute with 120 at the default. The register is a single byte shifted left on each clock. The seven stage outputs are bits 0 to 6 of the register before the shift; index order is bottom to top on the panel, output 0 being the lowest jack. Output 7 is the byte itself scaled by ten divided by 255. The threshold on the +1 jack depends on the Pulse Mode setting: 2V and edge-triggered in one mode, 1V and level-sensitive in the other. Pulse Mode and its two choices Gate and Trig are read from AdriftWidget::appendContextMenu. The button parameter has no name configured, so nothing but this entry describes it.
